Similarly, Ziprasidone is linked to a ventricular septal defect, caused by fluorouracil, which also binds to Cyp1a2. This indicates that Ziprasidone may indirectly affect Cyp1a2 through the metabolic pathways of its causative agents.

The evidence supports a mechanistic link between Ziprasidone and Cyp1a2, though the exact nature of the interaction remains unclear. The lowest common ancestor of Ziprasidone and its causative agents points to a broader class of compounds, suggesting that the observed effects may be part of a larger metabolic network.
